description: Change the Steam workshop items of a gameserver: addItemIds / removeItemIds edit the current list, itemIds replaces it, collectionId sets or (null) removes the collection, disabledItemIds keeps items listed but inactive. Omitted fields stay as they are. Applied on the next start/restart. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: update_gameserver_workshop
title: Update Game Server Steam Workshop
